instructions: Cut the stems off the romaine hearts and slice the leaves into thin ribbons. Rinse them in cold water, then dry them well in a salad spinner or between clean towels.
Thinly slice 3 of the scallions, white and green parts. Chop about 1/4 cup of the dill.
Transfer the romaine, scallions and dill to a large bowl.
In a small bowl or jar, whisk together the olive oil, the juice of the lemon (that should be about 3 tbsp), the salt and the pepper until it looks creamy.
Pour the dressing over the salad just before you eat and toss with tongs until every leaf is shiny. Wet leaves go limp, so don't dress it early.
Serve right away as a side or as a light lunch.
method_notes: All three sources agree on the build: sliced romaine, scallions, dill, olive oil and lemon, dressed at the last minute. They all add feta (4 to 6 oz); it's left out here because the list asks for vegan, and the dish is traditionally just greens, dill and dressing. Salt is raised from the sources' 1/4 tsp to 1/2 tsp to make up for the feta. No source had 20 ratings (best was 19), and RecipeTin Eats has no version, so the 5.0 from 19 version leads.
